summary: National Bankshares Inc. filed an 8-K on July 2, 2026, announcing a strategic repositioning of its securities available-for-sale portfolio. The company sold securities with a $131.87 million amortized cost and 1.80% yield, then purchased securities with a $127.33 million cost and 5.16% yield, incurring a $6.55 million pre-tax loss. This loss is offset by a gain from a previously announced sale of a membership interest in Bearing Insurance Group, LLC. The repositioning is a routine asset-liability management action, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
